transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start off, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me today?

Um… I guess work has just been feeling a little uncomfortable lately. I’m sure there’s probably some normal oversight, and I don’t want to sound like I’m making a big deal out of it, but it feels like dispatch and compliance are watching my route changes through the computer system.

And there’ve been little comments on the radio that seem… kind of pointed, like they know what I’m doing. People tell me it’s just regular tracking, but I can tell some of the other drivers are reporting on me. That’s why I thought maybe I should talk to someone, if that makes sense.
How long have you been noticing these feelings that dispatch or coworkers are watching or reporting on you—days, weeks, or longer?

Um… probably longer than just days. I don’t want to overstate it, but it’s felt pretty clear to me for maybe the past two months or so—the computer tracking and the radio comments and all that. At first I tried to tell myself it was just normal work stuff, but… yeah, around two months.
Besides these thoughts about being watched, have you noticed anything unusual with your senses—like hearing voices, sounds, or seeing things that others don't seem to notice?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, not like voices or seeing things, if that’s what you mean. Sometimes I’m probably just more alert to the radio or noises at work because of the situation, but I haven’t noticed anything that I’d call… unusual with my senses. Does that answer it okay?

Over these past two months, have you also noticed any changes in your mood—like feeling unusually sad, hopeless, or on the other hand, unusually energetic, elated, or needing much less sleep than normal?

Um… not really, I don’t think. I mean, it’s been stressful, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been, like, hopeless or anything. And I don’t think I’ve had those times where I’m super energetic or not needing sleep. Maybe just normal ups and downs with all this going on… if that makes sense.
Have you been using any drugs, alcohol, or new medications, or have you had any recent illnesses, head injuries, or medical problems around the time these feelings started?

Um… no, not that I can think of. I don’t really have anything like that to point to. No new medications or, like, injury that I know of. I’ve been trying to think if there was some illness or something around then, but nothing stands out to me. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?

Since these concerns about being watched started, have you noticed any changes in how well you're able to function at work, keep up with relationships, or take care of daily things like eating or sleeping?

A little, yeah… I mean, I’m still going to work and everything, so I don’t want to make it sound like I’ve completely fallen apart. But I have fallen behind on some of the route reports, and I guess my instructions haven’t been as clear as they should be. A few drivers have complained that what I’m giving them is confusing.

At home, my husband’s been helping more… well, taking over more, honestly. Meals, phone calls, planning basic stuff. I just haven’t been keeping up with it the way I normally would. I feel bad saying that, but… is that the kind of change you’re asking about?

Before these past two months when the watching and radio comments became clear to you, did you notice any smaller changes—like feeling more suspicious, withdrawn, or 'not quite yourself'—going back further, maybe four to six months ago?

Yeah… I guess if I’m being honest, it didn’t just start two months ago. It was more like it had been building for a while.

Maybe around eight months ago? Around when I was put into the temporary dispatch lead role. I thought it was just stress from that, so I didn’t really… count it, I guess. But looking back, that’s probably when I started feeling a little off, before it got clearer recently. Is that what you mean?

Over these past several months, have you noticed yourself feeling less interested in things you used to enjoy, having less motivation to do daily activities, or feeling emotionally flat or distant from people around you?

Yeah… maybe some. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, because I’m still getting through the day, but I haven’t really felt like doing the things I normally like.

Like choir… I used to enjoy singing, and having the softball team over sometimes, but lately I just don’t really feel like it. And after my shift, a lot of days I’ll sit at the kitchen table with my planner open, like I’m going to start dinner or make calls or organize something, and I just… don’t start. I kind of sit there.

I don’t know if that counts as motivation or just being tired, but it’s been happening. Is that what you mean?

Have you noticed any times when your thoughts feel jumbled or hard to organize, or when people have told you that your speech or behavior seemed confusing or hard to follow, separate from the situation with dispatch?

Maybe a little… I mean, not all the time. I can usually explain myself if I slow down.

At work, though, I do get kind of stuck sometimes. Like I’ll rearrange the magnets and route slips on the board into a certain pattern, and if it doesn’t feel right I have to fix it before I can move on. Or a driver will say something, and I’ll repeat the last few words back before I answer. I know that probably looks strange.

People have looked at me like I’m being difficult or wasting time, but I’m not trying to. It’s more like I’m trying to keep the whole board from going wrong, if that makes sense. I’m not sure if that’s what you mean by confusing behavior.
